title: Phase 60 opens Evidence Cycle 001 and proves end-to-end receipt propagation
summary: Thirteen existing evidence gates now share a no-silent-overdue operating contract and a public cycle export. The August 11 DARPA No Material Change receipt is propagated through its source, held signal decision, adoption dossier, pathway, dependency map, Outcomes Watch, and the first cycle digest.
evidence_note: Phase 60 publishes a schedule, propagation contract, and bounded no-change proof. It does not pre-complete any future check, claim that missing evidence does not exist, or add a source, signal, promotion, gap resolution, score, ranking, or operating outcome.
prior_state: The DARPA result signal was In Review and the receipt was visible in the Phase 58 queue, Research Watch, and update log.
current_state: The signal remains In Review and the same bounded receipt now propagates through the canonical adoption, pathway, map, Outcomes Watch, Evidence Cycle, and update surfaces.
publication_effect: Publishes one operating-cycle briefing, one static cycle export, and the complete propagation trail without changing the underlying evidence state.
